n: Chinese Wikipedia dates Gilgamesh's reign to about 2600 BC, not 2700.
n_zh: 中文维基百科称吉尔伽美什统治期大约在公元前2600年，而非2700年。

n: Wikipedia gives Urukagina ruling c. 2378-2371 BC (died c. 2368), earlier than the 2350 date.

n: Wikipedia says chariots reached Egypt with the Hyksos around 1700 BCE.

n: Chinese Wikipedia dates the papyrus's copying to about 1650 BC.

n: Wikipedia says the Western Stream of Bantu expansion began between 5000 and 3000 BC.

n: Wikipedia says Tlatilco culture flourished 1250-800 BCE, not from 1400.

n: Wikipedia says the colossal heads date from at least 900 BCE.

n: Wikipedia dates the Four-goat Zun to late Shang, 11th-10th century BC.

n: Chinese Wikipedia dates Lycurgus c. 700-630 BC, active 7th century BC.

n: Wikipedia says the Adena culture existed from 500 BC to 100 AD.

n: Chinese Wikipedia says Yeha appeared around 400 BC.

n: Chinese Wikipedia says Lydia began minting coins around 640 BC.

n: Wikipedia says coinage was introduced to the Greek world in the 7th century BC.

n: Wikipedia says the Li Sao dates from the 3rd century BCE.

n: Wikipedia says the Book of Han was finished in 111 CE (Ban Gu d. 92), not 82.
